General {npc:Bunny Bonecrusher}, of Carlin, sends you to deliver a package of supplies to the Femor Hills watchtower. There, {npc:Thanita} will only give you the delivery password if you rid her of the {creature:Goblin Leader}, whom you have to make leave his room by setting fire to his bed. As a reward you receive 200 elemental arrows.
Needs no Premium and no minimum level (10+ recommended).
140 oz of free capacity for the reward.
to set fire to the Goblin Leader's bed
The reward weighs **140 oz** in total: make sure you have capacity **before** talking to Bunny at the end, or you will not receive it.
In a team, only the player who deals the most damage (most experience) to the Goblin Leader receives Thanita's password.

Go up to the castle of **Carlin** and talk to {npc:Bunny Bonecrusher}. Greet her with {key:hi} and then {key:hail general} (she demands to be addressed properly). Say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Parcel (Watchtower)|parcel} to take to the watchtower at Femor Hills. If you are not in Carlin, take a boat and tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}.

{wiki:Femor Hills} are **east** of Carlin, **south-west** of Ab'Dendriel and **north** of Kazordoon: leave Carlin and walk **east**. With Premium you can take a {wiki:Magic Carpet} (Darashia, Edron, Farmine, Svargrond, Kazordoon or Issavi: {key:hi}, {key:femor hills}, {key:yes}); you land on top of a hill in the **south-west** of the hills, next to {npc:Uzon}, and go down to the ground. Go to **Femor Hills** and go up one level by any of the entrances. Keep walking until you see a tower; on the **left** side there are some stairs. Climb them, enter the watchtower and climb to the top.
It is not the tower with the fast-growing grass: it is the watchtower.
Femor Hills map, one floor up
Femor Hills map at ground level

At the top of the tower, talk to {npc:Thanita}: {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She opens the parcel and only gives you the password if you kill the goblin leader. The goblins do not like fire and their beds are made of straw.

The entrance to the goblin cave is next to the lake **south-east** of the tower. Go in and follow the whole path to the room of the {creature:Goblin Leader} (near the {wiki:Power Ring Quest|Power Ring Quest}).
Along the way there are {creature:Goblin|Goblins}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.
Go through the sealed door: to open it, **right-click** it (use).
Use the {item:Fire Bug} on the **bed**. The locked door opens and the Goblin Leader runs out.
Kill the {creature:Goblin Leader}. Do not be afraid: he is easy to kill and gives 75 experience.
In a team, whoever deals the most damage is the only one who receives the password.

Go back the same way to the cave entrance ({coord:32576,31798,7}), using the {item:Rope} on any hole you went down. Then return to the watchtower, going up one level again in Femor Hills and up the stairs on the left side of the tower.
Go back to {npc:Thanita} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. She tells you the password, which is different for each character: **massacre**, **doom**, **slaughter** or **bunny slippers**.
If you forget, the password is kept in the quest log: Quest Log → Tibia Tales → Password from Thanita.

Go back to Carlin, to {npc:Bunny Bonecrusher}. Say {key:hi}, {key:hail general}, {key:mission} and then your password (for example {key:massacre}). You receive the elemental arrows.

To return, go down the tower and the hills and walk **west** to Carlin (or, with Premium, take the carpet of {npc:Uzon}: {key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}). Bunny is in the castle, 2 floors up ({coord:32315,31753,5}).
Make sure you have 140 oz of free capacity before talking to her.
50 Shiver Arrows, 50 Earth Arrows, 50 Flaming Arrows and 50 Flash Arrows
